title: Dates ignore the locale, and due dates are formatted as 'time ago' with no overdue state

An overdue task reads '3 days ago' in a neutral badge, and tomorrow reads as a raw date. formatTime is English with hand-made plurals (activity, comments). DateTimeFormElement calls date-fns format() without a locale. TaskActivityCard uses toLocaleDateString() with the browser locale, not the app locale. formatDateTime uses UTC getters.
